LanguageData.HE_Inti_Sling.label: sling
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Sling.description: A braided sling of black and white alpaca wool with a woven cradle. Cheap, light and dangerous in practised hands.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Sling.tools.0.label: limb
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Champi.label: star mace
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Champi.description: A six-pointed bronze star on a hardwood staff. It crushes helmets and quilted armour alike.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Champi.tools.0.label: haft
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Champi.tools.1.label: head
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Carbine.label: mountain carbine
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Carbine.description: A short, light carbine with a leather sling and a condor stamped on the lock. Quick to bring up on a narrow ledge.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Carbine.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Carbine.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Chuki.label: chuki lance
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Chuki.description: A long hardwood lance with a bronze leaf blade and a tuft of coloured wool. The royal guard holds the line with it on the mountain roads.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Chuki.tools.0.label: shaft
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Chuki.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Bolas.label: bolas
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Bolas.description: Three cord-wrapped stones on braided cords. Whirled and thrown, they wrap around the legs of man or llama and knock the wind out of them.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Bolas.tools.0.label: limb
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Arquebus.label: Inti arquebus
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Arquebus.description: An arquebus bound in gold, its stock inlaid with tocapu squares that name the workshop that made it and the sun it serves. Short and light, it comes up to aim faster than any other powder arm.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Arquebus.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Arquebus.tools.1.label: barrel
